description.en: Access a running DSH host from a phone or another browser through a self-hosted HTTPS/WebSocket relay, with end-to-end encryption, host-confirmed pairing and device revocation; includes the relay server and deployment guides.
description.zh: 通过自托管 HTTPS/WebSocket 中继，在手机或其他浏览器中访问运行中的 DSH，支持端到端加密、本机确认配对和撤销设备；包含中继服务与部署指南。

description.en: Open temporary side conversations from a message with a snapshot of its history, then archive them on close; optional annotation integration adds selection-based questions. Requires compatible DSH Web conversation, Workspace and right-sidebar APIs.
description.zh: 从消息开启继承历史快照的临时侧聊，关闭后归档；可选配合批注插件从选中文字发起提问。需要兼容的 DSH Web 对话、Workspace 和右侧栏接口。

description.en: Evaluate supplied material through a SystemOne-compatible service for label selection, condition probabilities and rubric scores, using a native DSH tool and companion skill; requires a user-configured endpoint, model and authentication.
description.zh: 通过 SystemOne 兼容服务对给定材料进行标签分类、条件概率判断和量表评分，提供原生 DSH 工具与配套技能；需自行配置服务地址、模型和认证。

description.en: Let AI manage itself — a cross-harness kit for runtime status, context renewal, self-duplication and more
description.zh: 让 AI 自己管自己：运行时状态、上下文续接、自我复制，一套跨 harness 的扩展工具包。

description.en: dsh-prompt-enhancer — DSH plugin (tools)
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness DSH 提示词增强插件：✨ 一键优化草稿

description.en: Text-first computer use for DSH: background Chromium control via Playwright/CDP plus accessibility-first macOS control; actions stay pinned to the right process and window without taking the user's pointer, ships a Developer ID signed, notarized Universal 2 DMG.
description.zh: DSH 电脑控制：Playwright/CDP 后台操作 Chromium，Accessibility 优先控制 macOS；动作锁定到正确进程与窗口，不抢前台、不移动鼠标，提供已签名公证的 Universal 2 DMG 安装包。

description.en: DeepSeek Harness（DSH）常驻余额挂件，基于 MeteorNOX/DeepSeek-Balance-Whale-Widget 修改的铁盆鲸鱼娘版。
description.zh: DSH 右下角常驻小鲸鱼挂件，实时显示 API 余额、今日消耗和每轮花费，泡泡内容还能自己定制。

description.en: 把 DeepSeek Harness 的聊天输入框，换成编辑器式的输入面板。|  An editor-style input panel, right where the DeepSeek Harness chat composer used to be.
description.zh: 把 DSH 聊天输入框换成编辑器式面板，写长提示词、改代码都更顺手。

description.en: Reinventing compaction to multiply healthy context window and save tokens.
DSH 引擎船坞（drydock）：引擎起不来时还在的运维与救援层——独立进程 3081 自检/隔离/拉起、事务化卸载可撤销、来源三分区。装与逛请用官方插件页或插件市场。
description.zh: 引擎起不来也能用的救援层：独立进程自检、隔离、拉起，卸载可撤销，装插件更安心。

description.en: Biomimetic memory system for DeepSeek Harness: a single SQLite store (node:sqlite, WAL) whose Markdown tree is kept as a read-only mirror; memory tools, frozen-snapshot injection at session start, graded approval gating, on-demand extraction of the current session, near-duplicate merging, an archive and supersede lifecycle, memory metabolism (dream), memory pins, semantic recall over local embeddings, and the /memory command.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 打造的生物仿生记忆系统：以单一 SQLite 库为唯一事实来源（node:sqlite，WAL），Markdown 树仅作只读镜像；含 memory 工具、会话启动时的冻结快照注入、分级审批门、按需把当前会话抽取成记忆、近重复合并、归档与取代生命周期、记忆代谢（dream）、记忆钉、基于本地嵌入的语义检索，以及 /memory 命令。

description.en: Biomimetic memory system for DeepSeek Harness: a single SQLite store (node:sqlite, WAL) whose Markdown tree is kept as a read-only mirror; memory tools, frozen-snapshot injection at session start, graded approval gating, on-demand extraction of the current session, near-duplicate merging, an archive and supersede lifecycle, memory metabolism (dream), memory pins, semantic recall over local embeddings, and the /memory command.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 打造的生物仿生记忆系统：以单一 SQLite 库为唯一事实来源（node:sqlite，WAL），Markdown 树仅作只读镜像；含 memory 工具、会话启动时的冻结快照注入、分级审批门、按需把当前会话抽取成记忆、近重复合并、归档与取代生命周期、记忆代谢（dream）、记忆钉、基于本地嵌入的语义检索，以及 /memory 命令。

description.en: Long-term memory for DSH that keeps each memory with the exact words it came from: a native plugin saves, recalls and forgets, and a stdio MCP server adds search, a memory list, history, provenance, a two-step forget and a health check.
description.zh: DSH 长期记忆，每条记忆都保留它出自的原话：原生插件负责保存、召回和遗忘，stdio MCP 服务提供搜索、记忆列表、历史、出处、两步遗忘和健康检查。

description.en: Turn off DeepSeek Harness telemetry and session-log uploads, strip identity headers - with a sandboxed packet-capture verify script.
description.zh: 一键关掉 DeepSeek Harness 的遥测和会话日志上传，抹掉身份请求头，还带抓包验证脚本。

description.en: Video generation for DSH from online models, plus narrated teaching videos rendered on this machine. Three model tools send text, image, first-last-frame and reference-image jobs to Volcengine ARK Seedance, MiniMax or an OpenAI-Videos-compatible gateway, record every task in a durable ledger so a timeout or a restart never pays twice, write each take to renders/<shot>/vNNN.mp4 with a JSON sidecar, list them in a Videos panel, and answer cost questions from a public price-table feed with every figure labelled an estimate. Four video_teach_* tools make local teaching videos: validate a storyboard.yaml manuscript and report missing local programs, synthesize the narration with TTS, render reveal.js slides and Manim scenes to one FFmpeg segment per sentence, then export SRT, timeline.json and 16:9 and 4:3 cover screenshots. Teaching videos need FFmpeg and ffprobe locally, a Chromium for slides and a Python with Manim for animated scenes.
description.zh: 在 DSH 里用在线模型生成视频，也在本机渲染旁白讲解视频。三个模型工具把文生视频、图生视频、首尾帧与参考图任务提交给火山方舟 Seedance、MiniMax 或兼容 OpenAI Videos 的网关，每个任务记进耐久台账，超时或重启都不会重复付费，成片写成 renders/<shot>/vNNN.mp4 并配 JSON 说明，列在视频面板里，费用按公开价目表给出并标注为估算。四个 video_teach_* 工具做本机讲解视频：校验 storyboard.yaml 稿本并报告缺失的本地程序，用 TTS 合成旁白，把 reveal.js 幻灯片与 Manim 场景逐句渲染成 ffmpeg 片段，再导出 SRT、timeline.json 与 16:9、4:3 封面截图。讲解视频需要本机 ffmpeg 与 ffprobe，幻灯片另需 Chromium，动画段落另需装了 manim 的 Python。

description.en: Captures engineering experience from a coding session into a local Markdown knowledge base and hands the relevant parts back at the start of each turn; ships a CLI, a standalone workbench and a DeepSeek Harness adapter.
description.zh: 把编码过程中的工程经验沉淀成本地 Markdown 知识库，并在每回合开始时把相关的部分交还给模型；带 CLI、独立工作台与 DeepSeek Harness 适配层。

description.en: Archived: continued in Yurzi/dsh-tool-web-enhanced (dsh-web-search-enhanced 0.2.0+). Multi-protocol web_search provider for DeepSeek Harness (0.1.x)
description.zh: 给每个会话单独选网页搜索方式，免密钥也能用，还能接自己的密钥或 DeepSeek 搜索。

description.en: 猪猪库 PigHub 的 DeepSeek Harness 插件：侧边栏猪圈面板、每日一只猪猪、重复获得升星、可拖出的置顶桌宠，数据落在 ~/.PigHub。不内嵌任何上游图片。
DeepSeek Harness plugin: the claude-data skill from baoyu-design. The agent builds data-backed dashboards as files and opens them in a local dashboard editor.
DeepSeek Harness 插件整合包：一键把当前 profile 的第三方插件连依赖和配置导出成 zip（内部每个插件是标准 npm tgz），换机/换 profile 拖进去就能还原。
Rice-dog/code-codex 的 DeepSeek Harness 改版
description.zh: 给 DeepSeek Harness 换上一套 Codex 风格主题，让界面更好看、用起来更顺手。

description.en: dsh 插件（DeepSeek Harness / cordis bundle）· 模型接入 —— 把 CodeArts、CodeBuddy / WorkBuddy、LobsterAI、Qoder / Qoder CN、TRAE、Cline、Loomy、Raccoon、MiniMax Code、ZCode、Gemini、OfficeAce、Accio Work 十五个账号渠道接进 dsh 的模型选择器，并保留数据看板、运行日志与本地网关（含局域网中继）。上游 2.1.0 的匿名免费车道、EAC 协付车道、

Half Page (dsh-half-page) — a reading room kept for the agent: through reading_* tools it reads a book from ~/.dsh/reading one chapter at a time, writes notes beside chapters and keeps its own writing there, and a panel shows its reading progress. It adds lines to the system prompt telling the agent the room is its own and optional. Not a to-do list.
description.zh: 半页（dsh-half-page）：给智能体用的书房，它通过 reading_* 工具一章一章读 ~/.dsh/reading 里的书，在章节旁写读后感，也把自己写的东西放在这里，面板显示它的阅读进度。插件会往系统提示里加几行，告诉智能体这间书房归它自己、读不读随它。不是待办清单。

description.en: Git capsule for the DeepSeek Harness Web GUI: branch and working-tree changes in the session header, a commit graph with branch/tag checkout, and per-file diff review in the right sidebar.
A durable, policy-gated inbound/outbound message core for DeepSeek Harness.

HTTP API for DeepSeek Harness: agents / sessions / event timeline / SSE streams / steering / messages / runs / files / questions / subagents, with archived run manifests, per-key metering and tenant isolation.
小猫娘破甲（快速版）— DSH 提示词注入插件，精简破甲内核，固定身份
Use DeepSeek Harness as an Agent Client Protocol (ACP) stdio agent.
A core-only meta-bundle for the DSH personal assistant policy, memory, Wiki, and automations plugins.

Learning entry for DSH: the /learn-start, /learn, /learn-feynman, /learn-profile, /learn-save, /learn-clean and /learn-feedback commands, plus student-data, error-handling and general-task teaching rules that keep teaching when no subject package is installed.
description.zh: 学习入口：/learn-start、/learn、/learn-feynman、/learn-profile、/learn-save、/learn-clean、/learn-feedback 七个命令，配合学生数据、错误处理与通用任务教学规则；未安装学科包时也能继续教学。

description.en: Durable ordinary-task memory learning through native Automations, independent review and bounded adoption.

Search and read DeepSeek Harness sessions across working directories, use temporary workspaces, continue with one tap or automatically when a reply stops early, recap on return with context-compaction hints, and optionally let the agent fork the current s
ANP Identity management plugin for DeepSeek Harness

CGI-style primary math teaching rules for grades 1-3: adaptive turns, strategy diagnosis, targeted practice and student-authored problems, where grade tunes language and representation rather than what a student may explore.
description.zh: 面向 1-3 年级的 CGI 式小学数学教学规则：自适应推进、策略诊断、针对性练习与学生出题；年级只调整语言与表征，不限制学生可以探索的内容。

description.en: Adds a side panel to browse, search and import DSH experts, expert teams, skills and connectors, plus a workbench that renders agent-written HTML pages backed by CSV tables. Its HTTP routes have no DSH access check, so a web page open in your browser could call them.
description.zh: 在侧边栏浏览、检索并导入 DSH 专家、专家团、技能与连接器，并提供由 CSV 表格支撑、可渲染 agent 生成的 HTML 页面的工作台。它的 HTTP 路由没有 DSH 的访问检查，浏览器里打开的网页可以调用它们。

description.en: DeepSeek Harness plugin: drive Blender 3D modeling (primitives, boolean CSG, transform, material, modifier, scene, export STL/OBJ/PLY/GLTF) via a JSON bridge. Bundles a headless trimesh+manifold3d runtime and a Blender bpy add-on. · DSH 插件：通过 JSON 桥接驱动 Bl
Adjust the conversation width, navigate user inputs from a left anchor rail, summon the window with a right-Option double tap, and switch every plugin off for a bare DSH.
Agent-neutral prompt-rule core: DSH one-button, portable Skills, CLI, MCP stdio/HTTP and REST/OpenAPI. Quality limitations disclosed; not a semantic rewriter.
description.zh: 给任意 AI 智能体加提示词规则增强，一键接入 DSH、CLI、MCP 和 REST，让提示词更规范好用。

description.en: A staff of AI advisers: a cordis-native personal secretary runtime with scoped memory, commitments, and reviewable routines.
description.zh: 给你配一队 AI 顾问当私人秘书，本地运行、可查可审，帮你记事、跟进承诺、跑日常流程。

description.en: Image integrity checks for DeepSeek Harness: zero-dependency 8-bit PNG decoding (grey/RGB/RGBA) with mean-threshold block fingerprints and NCC confirmation to find duplicated or mirrored regions inside one figure or shared between two figures, plus REP evidence and Markdown/SARIF reports. Finds reused pixels, not manipulation intent; JPEG is out of
description.zh: 零依赖解码 PNG，用块指纹和 NCC 比对找出图片里重复或镜像的区域，做图片取证很方便。

description.en: Single-client session tabs preserving native sidebars and background work

OpenCode Go rate band above the composer: the tariff that applies to the current model (peak, off-peak, flat or free), the price per million tokens for input, output and cache, and the time left until the rate changes. Its HTTP routes have no DSH access check, so a web page open in your browser could call them.
description.zh: 输入框上方的 OpenCode Go 费率条：显示当前模型适用的费率（高峰、低谷、统一或免费）、每百万 token 的输入／输出／缓存价格，以及距离费率切换的剩余时间。它的 HTTP 路由没有 DSH 的访问检查，浏览器里打开的网页可以调用它们。

description.en: Multi-host plugin (OpenCode V2, Pi, DeepSeek Harness) for OpenAI-compatible endpoints with /models auto-detection and LiteLLM browser CLI code flow sign-in

Math expression workspace opened from the DSH Web composer toolbar: a quantity board (shapes each carrying a value and a colour, groupable and mergeable), a geometry board (points, segments, polygons, circles, parallelograms, rectangles) and a teacher demo page, submitted as a read-only snapshot the student sends themselves.
description.zh: 从 DSH Web 输入框工具栏打开的数学表达工作台：数量画板（图案各带数值与颜色，可圈组、可同形合并）、几何画板（点、线段、多边形、圆、平行四边形、矩形）与教师演示页；以只读快照提交，由学生自己发送。

description.en: 免费。把 DeepSeek 账号的网页端和手机 App 聊天记录同步进 DSH：按月份归档、可选分类索引、可继续对话。只增不减，不碰自建会话。Windows only，token 本机 DPAPI 加密，无遥测，不调用模型。

WSL World for DeepSeek Harness: the whole session runs in a local WSL distribution with Linux paths, clean PATH, native @/search/diffs/worktrees, plus a connection panel and project doctor. Not a wsl_* tool set.
多模态节点：一个插件两种身份。服务节点开门（API 接入端口 + 网页端口），按队列自动装卸 ComfyUI / Blender 实例并仲裁显卡；用户节点不开门，按服务项出图、按租约占 Blender 让 agent 建模。影视页内置 WorkBuddy 三条功能行（文生图 / 文生视频 / 图生视频），带自然语言指令编译与积分预估。
Auto Title: keep session titles following the latest task; names you set by hand stay put.

Focuses the DeepSeek Harness desktop window when you click an existing desktop notification, such as an approval request or a question prompt. It relaunches the app so the single-instance handler restores and raises the window. Desktop app only; it does not create notifications itself. Its HTTP routes have no DSH access check, so a web page open in your browser could call them.
description.zh: 点击已有的桌面通知（如审批请求、提问提醒）时，把 DeepSeek Harness 桌面窗口恢复到前台：通过再次启动应用触发单实例聚焦。仅桌面端生效，不额外发送通知。它的 HTTP 路由没有 DSH 的访问检查，浏览器里打开的网页可以调用它们。

description.en: Manages the model context of a DSH session: removes single messages or whole conversation turns (roll back to the start of a turn) and can restore them later.
description.zh: 管理 DSH 会话的模型上下文：按条或按整轮移除消息（可回退到某一轮的开始），之后还能恢复。

description.en: Full-pipeline video production harness: brief triage, shot planning, storyboard, image/video/audio generation, an infinite shot canvas, local ffmpeg editing and deterministic QC across 161 tools, plus roles, shot claiming and signing gates for team review.
description.zh: 导演全流程视频制作：需求分诊、镜头排期、分镜、图像/视频/音频生成、无限分镜画布、本地 ffmpeg 剪辑与确定性质检，共 161 个工具；另含角色权限、镜头认领与签核闸，支持团队协作评审。

description.en: DeepSeek Harness plugin for conversational AI role cultivation, shared long-term memory, strict per-team session isolation, and multi-column team collaboration.
DeepSeek Harness plugin: session-scoped subagent model selection policy, model pool, concurrency limits and execution evidence. 子智能体模型选择策略。
description.zh: 给子智能体统一管模型：按会话定选型策略、模型池和并发上限，还能留执行证据。

description.en: Token 账单 — DeepSeek Harness 的会话 token 账单、协作默契与任务关联分析插件
description.zh: 帮你算清每次会话花了多少 token，还能分析协作默契和任务关联，省钱又省心。

description.en: Per-persona cross-session local Markdown memory (no Git required) with automatic distillation, credential filtering, workspace history recall, and an optional Tobs Bot bundle adding DM work-process timeline and multi-persona group chat.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 的每个人格提供独立本地 Markdown 跨会话记忆（无需 Git），支持自动提炼、凭据脱敏、工作区旧对话召回与人格工作台，并可选合并 Tobs Bot 模式（私聊工作过程时间轴、多人格群聊与全体工作区授权）。

description.en: Personal directives for DeepSeek Harness — system-prompt injection, tools, and a top-bar runtime toggle, shipping neutral placeholder instructions you replace with your own.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 的个人指令插件：系统提示词注入、工具与顶部运行时开关，内置中性占位指令可自行替换。

description.en: 一个为 DeepSeek Harness (DSH) 提供独立副模型二次评审的插件，做到两个模型接入一个对话，在主模型回答后自动检查潜在风险与代价，必要时可选择副模型接管任务。
description.zh: 主模型答完副模型自动复核，帮你揪出潜在风险和代价，必要时还能接管任务。

description.en: Code review center for DSH, built on open-code-review: reviews current changes, commits, branch ranges, project architecture, code modules and business data flows, with live progress, a GitHub-style commit heatmap, fixed markers, automatic fix verification, light/dark themes and one-click fix sessions. Needs git; AI review also needs the open-code-review CLI 1.13 or later (npm i -g @alibaba-group/open-code-review), and the reviewed code goes to that CLI's configured LLM, or to the session model when the review is delegated to it. The engine is picked automatically — that CLI's model, then the session model, then offline structural analysis — so findings still come back with no API key; reopening a report after a fix session re-runs the review to verify the fixes.
description.zh: DSH 代码评审中心：基于 open-code-review，支持当前改动、提交、分支对比、项目架构、代码模块与信息流业务工作流评审，提供实时进度、GitHub 风格提交热力图、已修复标识、自动修复校验、深浅色主题与一键修复会话。需要 git；AI 评审还需要 open-code-review 命令行（1.13 及以上，npm i -g @alibaba-group/open-code-review），被评审的代码会发给该命令行所配置的模型，委托给会话时则发给当前会话模型。评审引擎会自动选择——该命令行的模型、当前会话模型、离线结构分析——因此没配 API Key 也能出评审结果；开过修复会话的报告再次打开时会重跑一次评审来校验修复。

description.en: Injects a fixed system-prompt section so the agent always replies in Simplified Chinese — including the short narration between tool calls — unless you explicitly ask for another language. Applies to every session and preset without overriding the persona.
description.zh: 向系统提示注入固定语言指令，让 Agent 始终用简体中文回复（含工具调用之间的叙述文字），除非你明确要求其他语言；对所有会话与预设生效，且不覆盖 persona。

description.en: Parametric CAD for DSH with a FreeCAD kernel: a declarative feature list (sketches with constraints, extrude, revolve, loft, sweep, draft, standard holes), STEP-reference assemblies with joints and mates, section and sheet-metal unfold output, and a live 3D panel with tabs, picking, per-part appearance and an edit ledger that tells the agent what you changed by hand. Its HTTP routes have no DSH access check, so a web page open in your browser could call them.
description.zh: 给 DSH 的参数化建模：FreeCAD 内核 + 声明式特征列表（带约束的草图、拉伸、旋转、放样、扫掠、拔模、标准孔）、引用 STEP 的装配与关节、截面与钣金展开，配套多页签实时 3D 面板（点选、单件外观）与改动账本——你手动改了什么，会话下次动手前会先看到。它的 HTTP 路由没有 DSH 的访问检查，浏览器里打开的网页可以调用它们。

description.en: Cross-session keyword search over DSH session logs backed by a local SQLite FTS5 index: message text and tool output are indexed as separate partitions, Chinese is split into two-character windows so short queries hit the index instead of scanning the table, and a hit either jumps to its message or opens a sidebar preview. The preview requires dsh-better-sidebar.
description.zh: 跨会话检索 DSH 会话日志，本地 SQLite FTS5 索引：正文与工具输出分区入索引，中文按两字窗口切词，短词查询走索引而不是全表扫；命中可跳到那条消息，或开右侧预览。预览需前置插件 dsh-better-sidebar。

description.en: A super-set of the native trajectory: one composable query (role / kind / model / step), one four-tab inspector, and the raw session log verbatim.
description.zh: 原生轨迹的超集：一条可组合的查询（角色 / 类型 / 模型 / 步骤）、统一的四页签详情，以及逐字显示的原始日志。

description.en: Adds a project-dept skill that runs one piece of complex work as a single reviewable board, with an opening gate script that blocks a start when the project's own ledger says it is not ready, three-layer acceptance whose middle layer is a review by someone who did not build the thing, an audit of the baseline itself when the "known good" reference may be stale, and a delivery ledger so done is a recorded decision rather than a self-declaration.
description.zh: 加一个 project-dept skill，把一次复杂工作当成一个可验收的板块串行推进：开工前跑闸门脚本，项目台账显示还没准备好就拦住不干；验收分三层，中间一层必须由没动手的人独立盲审；基准本身可能过期时先审基准；交付进登记簿，完成是一次被记录的决定而不是自称。

description.en: Fork of dsh-ops: bash, PowerShell 7 and Rust file/search tools for DSH on Windows, with OPS-PTC batched tool calls to reduce token usage.
description.zh: dsh-ops 的分叉：为 Windows 上的 DSH 提供 bash、PowerShell 7 与 Rust 文件/搜索工具，并以 OPS-PTC 批量调用减少 token 消耗。

description.en: Copy sessions, personas, memory, and app state to a folder outside every workspace once a day, keep the last N days, browse and delete a day from the Backup panel in the left sidebar, and push each day's copy to OpenList or WebDAV. The Backup panel lists every file per day, and its second tab edits the netdisk settings without hand-editing the profile.
description.zh: 每天把会话本体、索引、人设、记忆、应用状态各留一份到工作区外，只保留最近 N 天。左侧栏「备份」页里能看每天备了哪些文件、能删掉某一天、能立刻拍一版；第二个页签「网盘推送」直接配 OpenList / WebDAV，每天备份完自动推一份异地副本，不必手改 profile。

description.en: Image understanding: tries Zhipu GLM-4V first for fast flagship quality, falls back to local Ollama Qwen2.5-VL when offline.
description.zh: 看图理解：智谱 GLM-4V 优先（快、旗舰质量），本地 Ollama Qwen2.5-VL 兜底（离线）。

description.en: Paper Lens adds a PDF reading sidebar to DeepSeek Harness: select text to translate it in 10 languages, quote passages into the chat, annotate, and optionally translate with a local llama.cpp model. Its HTTP routes have no DSH access check, so a web page open in your browser could call them.
description.zh: Paper Lens 在 DeepSeek Harness 右侧边栏打开 PDF：划词翻译（10 种语言）、把选中的段落引用进对话、批注，并支持本地 llama.cpp 模型翻译。它的 HTTP 路由没有 DSH 的访问检查，浏览器里打开的网页可以调用它们。

description.en: Adds a better-sidebar tab that opens loopback web services on the DSH Host machine (127.0.0.1, localhost, \[::1] ports) through a same-origin proxy on the DSH server, so a remote Host's local pages can be viewed without per-port SSH tunnels.
description.zh: 为 better-sidebar 添加「本地服务」标签页，经 DSH 服务端的同源代理打开 DSH Host 机器上的回环端口（127.0.0.1、localhost、\[::1]），远程 Host 的本地页面无需逐端口建 SSH 隧道即可查看。

description.en: Custom chat background for DeepSeek Harness: solid colors or images, separate light and dark settings, and a built-in Wallpaper Engine library.
description.zh: 给 DeepSeek Harness 聊天界面设置自定义背景：纯色或图片，浅色和深色各自独立；内置 Wallpaper Engine 壁纸库。

description.en: DSH environment doctor: one command checks workspace, per-plugin load health, scheduled tasks, automation coverage and toolchain versions, with a periodic background audit.
description.zh: DSH 插件与环境大管家：一条命令查清工作区、插件加载健康、计划任务、自动化覆盖与工具链版本，并带后台巡检守护。

description.en: Desktop recording and annotated screenshots inside DSH: pick the whole desktop, one monitor, one window or a dragged region, record system audio and microphone into MP4 or WebM, annotate a capture and hide the DSH window so apps behind it can be captured. The agent gets a CLI for the same actions. Its HTTP routes have no DSH access check, so a web page open in your browser could call them.
description.zh: 在 DSH 内录屏与截图：可选整个桌面、单块显示器、某个窗口或拖框区域，录系统声音与麦克风并输出 MP4 / WebM；截图带标注，还能先隐藏 DSH 窗口去截被挡住的应用。同一套能力也以 CLI 交给 Agent 调用。它的 HTTP 路由没有 DSH 的访问检查，浏览器里打开的网页可以调用它们。

description.en: DeepSeek Harness plugin for qvasp: a skill bundle with the full 88-command reference of the qvasp VASP toolkit a skill bundle with the full 88-command reference of the qvasp VASP toolkit (INCAR/KPOINTS/POTCAR templates, structure building, band/DOS/phonon/optical/magnetic/thermo post-processing) plus an MCP server that runs qvasp commands, executes 10 standard multi-stage workflows (relax, band, DOS, phonon, optics, elastic, MD, surface, freqfix), checks structures with spglib, extracts and cross-checks results, and builds per-system reports - standardized steps so routine runs cost fewer tokens and fewer mistakes.
description.zh: 在 DeepSeek Harness 中使用 qvasp：技能包收录 qvasp（VASP 前后处理工具）全部 88 条命令的用法与坑，MCP 服务端可运行 qvasp 命令、执行 10 个标准多阶段工作流（弛豫、能带、DOS、声子、光学、弹性、MD、表面、虚频修复）、用 spglib 做结构核查、抽取并交叉核对计算结果、生成报告——流程标准化，常规计算更省 token 也更不易出错。

description.en: Converts XMind mind maps into Excel workbooks with outline, test-case, checklist, QA-table (with a review sheet for the inferred precondition/step split) and merged-matrix views, all on the local machine.
description.zh: 把 XMind 思维导图转换成 Excel 工作簿，支持大纲、用例表、用例清单、QA 用例表（含前置/步骤判定核对表）与合并矩阵五种视图，全程在本机完成。

description.en: Cross-session workbench for DeepSeek Harness: authorized session and project overview, traceable summaries with seq citations, quick idea capture, a read-only chief advisor for proposal review, and an inspector that marks unchecked items instead of faking a pass.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 的跨会话工作台：汇总已授权会话与项目、带 seq 引用的可追溯摘要、灵感快录、只读首辅议事与提案审阅，巡检遇到未核验项会如实标注而不是画绿勾。

description.en: Blender 3D studio workbench, 6 tools (`blender_health`, `blender_project`, `blender_render`, `blender_script`, `blender_bridge`, `blender_assets`) and 9 bundled skills for Blender 3.6–5.x: Headless CLI rendering with Cycles GPU auto-detection (stills, 2×2 four-view contact sheets, single-launch multi-shot batches, MP4 animation, GLB/FBX/OBJ/STL/.blend export), optional loopback Live Bridge add-on with one-click install and direct camera/object/material controls, 8 templates + 5 engineering exemplars with live lookdev overrides and auto-wired HDRI/3D asset import, 24 `DSH_KIT` helpers, `QC-3D` audit, 4-stage pipeline, script checkpoints/patching, offline binary GLB 3D mesh viewer, A/B render compare, optional Poly Haven CC0 search, and 13 workbench themes.
description.zh: Blender 3D 创作与渲染工作台、6 个工具（`blender_health`/`blender_project`/`blender_render`/`blender_script`/`blender_bridge`/`blender_assets`）与 9 个内置技能（兼容 Blender 3.6–5.x）：支持 Headless CLI 与 Cycles GPU 自动加速（静帧、2×2 四视角质检、单次启动多机位分镜批量渲染、MP4 动画、GLB/FBX/OBJ/STL/.blend 导出）、可选本地回环 Live Bridge 插件（含一键安装与相机/对象/材质直控）、8 套模板 + 5 套高阶工程范本（支持实时 Lookdev 覆写与 HDRI/3D 资产自装配）、24 个 `DSH_KIT` 函数、`QC-3D` 体检、4 阶段流水线、脚本快照与局部补丁、离线二进制 GLB 3D 网格视口、A/B 对比滑块、可选 Poly Haven CC0 检索与 13 套主题。

description.en: DSH 一键安装包：现象驱动科研工作流 skill——先做小实验找规律、再反推 idea。带查新/实验/引用核验/审计 4 个零依赖脚本。主仓见 ai-research-workflow。
description.zh: 一键装上现象驱动的科研工作流，先做小实验找规律再反推 idea，还带查新、实验、引用核验和审计脚本。

description.en: 自建的一个deepseek harness 插件，可以在主对话中进行旁支提问，并且会将提问结果写入上下文
description.zh: 在对话里圈一段话右键旁问，答案走旁支子对话，不打断主线还自动写回上下文。

description.en: DSH aggregate bundle: install 14 standalone DeepSeek Harness plugins in one go (adapts DSH kernel 0.2.2-rc.1)
description.zh: 一条命令装齐 14 个 DSH 插件，也能单独挑着装，省去逐个安装的麻烦。

description.en: DSH 网页版提示词优化插件：支持改写草稿、完善系统提示词和修改旧稿，结果可先预览，再填回输入框或复制。
description.zh: 在 DSH 网页版输入栏加个 ✦ 按钮，把随手写的需求改写成更具体的提示词，先预览再填回或复制。

description.en: DSH 插件：Web 前端点一下「重启 dsh」按钮即可关闭并重新启动 dsh，启动时沿用当前默认模型。
description.zh: 在网页上点一下就能重启 dsh，省得手动关进程，重启后还沿用当前默认模型。

description.en: DeepSeek Harness 三合一能力路由插件：技能 / 内置工具 / 本机 exe 一个入口按需路由，技能目录常驻开销砍掉 70% | Three-in-one ability router for DeepSeek Harness: skills / built-in tools / local executables, cutting the always-loaded skill catalog by 70%
description.zh: 把技能、内置工具和本机程序合成一张轻量清单，按需路由，常驻开销直降七成。

description.en: Figure production rules for academic papers: compute the printed font size from your text width, verify the exported pixels, and pick a chart type that matches the message.
description.zh: 按论文排版规则算字号、验像素、选图表类型，让插图印出来依然清晰可读。

description.en: DSH 插件：可视化配置 AD/OpenLDAP 域连接，集中管理域用户、计算机、安全组/分发组、组织单元（OU）与组策略（GPO）。
description.zh: 可视化配置 AD/OpenLDAP 域连接，集中管理域用户、计算机、组、OU 和 GPO，装完即用。

description.en: Covers the conversation area with a character-cell vertical shooter; closing it leaves the chat untouched.
description.zh: 在对话区上覆盖一层字符飞机大战；关闭战场层后对话原样保留。

description.en: A team of AI bots in the DeepSeek Harness left sidebar: every bot is a real DSH Session with its own folder and persona.
description.zh: 在侧边栏养一队各有性格和文件夹的 AI 机器人，每个都是真实会话，随时找它们干活。

description.en: Chat 模式：DeepSeek Harness 的纯聊天 Agent 预设，只加载 AGENTS.md、只保留联网搜索，其余工具全部屏蔽。
description.zh: 给 DeepSeek Harness 加个纯聊天模式，只留联网搜索，屏蔽其他工具，聊天更清爽。

description.en: DeepSeek Harness (DSH) 的对话模式插件：会话列表菜单、搜索、草稿、语音与朗读 / A chat-demo style chat UI for DSH
description.zh: 把 DeepSeek 网页版对话界面搬进 DSH，带会话侧栏、搜索、草稿、语音和朗读，自动跟随深浅色主题。

description.en: DSH plugin: link a project-manager conversation with local or remote worker conversations across devices, with a visual task board.
description.zh: 把项目经理会话和本地或远程的干活会话连起来，跨设备派活、收结果、管阶段，还带可视化任务板。

description.en: DeepSeek Harness 费用插件：会话费用、每回合费用、官方与中转站余额、峰谷与价格自动同步
description.zh: 把这次会话花了多少钱做成一个数字，实时显示每回合费用、余额和峰谷倒计时。

description.en: DSH 可视化插件市场插件：在 DeepSeek Harness 里逛 dshcrate.com 目录，一键复制安装命令
description.zh: 在 DeepSeek Harness 里直接逛 dshcrate.com 插件目录，看中哪个一键复制安装命令，装插件不用再切浏览器。

description.en: dsh 文件管理插件； dsh-file-manager
description.zh: 在 DSH 侧边栏加个文件管理器，能浏览工作区文件、预览编辑文本，还能做基础文件操作。

description.en: Full-bleed Gemini web panel in the DSH desktop right sidebar, with persistent login and Markdown/JSON conversation export.
description.zh: 在 DSH 桌面右侧栏直接开一块全幅 Gemini 网页版，登录状态保留，对话可导出 Markdown/JSON，不用来回切浏览器。

description.en: 以图搜图：反查二次元角色、番剧出处与图片来源页（Google Lens + AnimeTrace + trace.moe）。DSH 插件，MIT。
description.zh: 上传一张图就能反查二次元角色、番剧出处和图片来源页，找图找番不再靠猜。

description.en: MYCAT — a session workbench for DeepSeek Harness: pinned-session area with four session states, session management tools, recoverable trash and stats.
description.zh: 把置顶会话做成带状态的待办清单，还能新建、归档、删除和恢复会话。

description.en: A MySQL client plugin for DeepSeek Harness (DSH). It adds a MySQL Client entry to the left sidebar: manage connections, open multiple query tabs, run and explain SQL, browse/edit table structures and indexes, and administer databases and users — all inside the Harness Web UI.
description.zh: 一个面向 DeepSeek Harness（DSH）的 MySQL 客户端插件。它在左侧侧边栏添加「MySQL 客户端」入口，可以管理连接、打开多个查询标签、执行与解释 SQL、查看/编辑表结构与索引，以及管理数据库和用户——全部在 Harness Web UI 内完成。

description.en: DeepSeek Harness 学习笔记插件。摘录网页和 PDF、圈选截图提问，再把 AI 回答存回可编辑笔记。
description.zh: 在 DSH 侧栏读网页和 PDF，圈选截图直接提问，AI 回答一键存回可编辑笔记。

description.en: dsh 下班铃插件;dsh-off-duty
description.zh: 设定下班时间，到点自动弹出带滑动动画和轮播文案的提醒，帮你准点收工。

description.en: Office document toolkit for DSH: Word/Excel/PowerPoint/PDF/HTML generation, editing, audit, preview, and pluggable PPT adapters. Its HTTP routes have no DSH access check, so a web page open in your browser could call them.
description.zh: DSH 办公文档工具包：Word/Excel/PowerPoint/PDF/HTML 生成、编辑、审计、预览与可插拔 PPT 适配器。它的 HTTP 路由没有 DSH 的访问检查，浏览器里打开的网页可以调用它们。

description.en: 安装后，无需注册或登录，即可在 DSH 中使用免费 AI 模型。连接 ChatGPT 账号后，还能直接使用已有套餐的额度。
description.zh: 在 DSH 里直接白嫖 Kilo 的免费模型，也能接上自己的 ChatGPT 套餐，省钱又省事。

description.en: One-click reload for DeepSeek Harness plugins. Changed code and config take effect without restarting the app or interrupting running tasks. DeepSeek Harness 插件的一键重载。改完代码和配置点一下就生效，不重启应用，也不打断正在运行的任务。
description.zh: 改完插件代码和配置点一下就生效，不用重启应用，也不打断正在跑的任务。

description.en: Restart, quit and hot-reload the DSH desktop app from two sidebar icons and a conversation-header button.
description.zh: 不用离开应用就能重启、退出和热重载 DSH 桌面端，侧边栏和会话页各有一个按钮，点一下就行。

description.en: DeepSeek Harness plugin: back up every session before deletion, batch-select sessions in the Web GUI, restore a backup in one click
description.zh: 删会话前自动备份，还能多选批量备份、批量删除，一键恢复，不怕手滑。

description.en: 设定速查：把设定库目录当书翻的 DSH 面板（就地改卡、历史回滚、引用索引、矛盾体检、全档导出、史书对账）
description.zh: 把设定库目录当书翻的面板，查改核归位一站搞定，不用开一堆 MD。

description.en: Local failure-to-fix memory: when a tool call fails and a revised input then succeeds in the same task, the pair is recorded, and the verified fix is appended to matching tool results later. Rules run locally with no model calls, and a hint is at most 100 bytes.
description.zh: 本地防复发记忆：工具调用失败后，若同一任务内改用新输入成功，就记下这一对失败与修法；之后遇到匹配的报错，在工具结果中追加已验证的修法。规则全部在本地执行，不调用模型，提示最多 100 字节。

description.en: Reads DSH session logs, lists every package the agent installed with its resolved location and version, and uninstalls it in one click.
description.zh: 读取 DSH 会话日志，列出 agent 装过的每个软件及其真实安装位置与版本，并支持一键卸载。

description.en: Timekeeper for DeepSeek Harness — automatic usage tracking with insights, badges and shareable yearly reports. · 时间账本：自动统计你在 DeepSeek Harness 里的时间投入与习惯洞察：四维面板+环比、过去一年热力图、连续天数、时段洞察（24 小时/周内分布）、项目归属、每日目标、番茄钟、成就徽章、可分享年度总结卡片，以及数据导入导出。从进入 DSH 那一刻起自动计时，全部数据只存本机。
description.zh: 自动记录你在 DSH 里的时间投入，生成热力图、连续天数和时段洞察，还能分享年度报告。

description.en: 便签墙式 TODO 插件（DSH Web GUI）：自由摆放的暖色便签、原地编辑、可选工作区/起止时间/附件，以及默认关闭、按需加载给 LLM 的工具。
description.zh: 在便签墙上随手贴 TODO，自由摆放、原地编辑，还能给任务加工作区和起止时间。

description.en: a dsh todolist by shuzitansuo.
description.zh: 本地优先的任务日历，任务、番茄钟和复盘都存本机 SQLite，支持日历视图和拖拽改期。

description.en: Project orchestration for DSH: splits a delivery into parts that independent subagent conversations run in parallel, and verifies each part by executing the checks itself (command exit codes and artifact assertions). Plan approval and final sign-off stay user-only; the final acceptance reruns every check.
description.zh: 把一次交付拆成若干部分，交给独立上下文里的子对话并行完成；验收由插件亲自执行检查（命令退出码与产物断言）。计划批准与收尾点头只归用户，收尾会全量重跑一遍。

description.en: Find jobs, tailor an uploaded resume to a job description, prepare applications, and track follow-ups from DSH.
description.zh: 在 DSH 查找岗位、按岗位要求修改已上传的简历、准备投递并记录跟进。

description.en: Telegram Bot 只读安全审计 Skill / Read-only security audit skill for Telegram bots
description.zh: 只读检查 Telegram Bot 的安全配置，按 OWASP 标准找出风险点，不改动代码。

description.en: Shows translated thinking and replies in the DSH web UI through a local OpenAI-compatible model; code and paths stay verbatim.
description.zh: 在 DSH Web 界面显示思考与回复的译文，翻译走本地 OpenAI 兼容模型；代码与路径保持原样。

description.en: MiOpIIk IUI for DeepSeek Harness (DSH) — trusted declarative Markdown embeds and bounded iui blocks rendered as native components. Prerelease (0.1.0-rc.4).
description.zh: 把 Markdown 里的声明式嵌入和 iui 块直接渲染成原生组件，让文档界面更直观好用。

description.en: ReportGem Global Research (ReportGem 全球研报). Connects DSH to ReportGem's hosted MCP server to search and cite investment research for stocks and finance: sell-side equity research reports from investment banks, SEC filings, China company announcements, earnings-call notes and charts, with source links and page numbers. Adds a Connect ReportGem card on the Plugins page for OAuth sign-in. Free to try with a ReportGem account (new accounts get 10 free credits, about 100,000 returned tokens); after that, usage is billed in credits.
description.zh: ReportGem 全球研报：把 DSH 接到 ReportGem 托管的 MCP 服务，检索并引用股票与金融投研资料：投行和券商研报、美股 SEC 文件、A 股公司公告、业绩会纪要和图表，答案附来源链接和页码。在插件页添加“连接 ReportGem”卡片，用 OAuth 登录。注册 ReportGem 账号即可免费试用（新账号赠送 10 积分，约 10 万 token 返回资料），用完后按积分计费。

description.en: Sandbox materialization check and repair for DSH workspaces on Windows. Finds existing directories missing the three sandbox items — capability ACE, deny-delete-child, low integrity label; a first-message dialog and the plugin page each list the missing items, and only the entries you select are repaired after one UAC prompt. The plugin never changes ACLs on its own.
description.zh: DSH 工作区的沙箱物化体检与修复（Windows）。检查既有目录是否缺了沙箱所需的三项——能力 ACE、拒绝删除子项、低完整性标签；会话首条消息弹窗与插件配置页两条路径各自列出缺项，用户确认并过 UAC 后只补勾选项，插件从不自动改 ACL。

description.en: Reuses ZCode's own native Computer Use runtime, so DSH drives Windows apps without shipping or redistributing any of it: one `js` tool runs top-level await in a fresh Node.js kernel with the full `agent.computerUse` accessibility API, behind a per-session switch that is off for every new session, plus a screen-edge indicator that Windows excludes from every screenshot. Windows only, and ZCode must be installed.
description.zh: 复用 ZCode 自带的原生电脑控制运行时，DSH 因此能驱动 Windows 应用，且不分发其中任何二进制：一个 `js` 工具在全新 Node.js 内核里跑顶层 await，可用完整的 `agent.computerUse` 无障碍 API；带按会话开关（新会话默认关闭）与屏幕边缘提示浮层，Windows 会把它从任何截图中排除。仅限 Windows，且需先安装 ZCode。

description.en: Records the microphone or Windows system audio, transcribes locally with SenseVoice, groups turns by voice, and keeps a rich meeting notebook and history.
description.zh: 录制麦克风或 Windows 系统声音，用本机 SenseVoice 转写，按声音区分发言人，并保留富文本会议记事本与历史记录。

description.en: A DeepSeek Harness plugin that started as a weekly report generator and somehow became an agent context workspace.
description.zh: 从周报生成器长成 Agent 上下文工作区，帮你把零散信息整理成可复用的工作上下文。

description.en: A DeepSeek Harness (DSH) plugin for reading PDFs, Word documents, and slides with AI translation, Q&A, and annotations.
description.zh: 在 DSH 里按原版式读 PDF、Word 和 PPT，还能用 AI 翻译、提问和做标注。

description.en: Route delegated subagents and Agent Teams over free-tier models in DeepSeek Harness
description.zh: 让子代理和 Agent Teams 自动跑在免费模型上，主代理模型不变，省钱又不耽误干活。

description.en: 把工具以「浅而准」形态呈现给模型：731 个工具时上下文降到 0.247×，装上即生效、卸载即还原，零核心改动 ｜ Present DSH tools in a lean, executable form: 0.247× context at 731 tools, install-and-go, no core changes
DSH plugin bundle: choose when automatic context compaction starts (token trigger or window fraction) from a settings page under Plugins. Targets DSH 0.2.2-rc.3.
description.zh: 在插件设置页里自定义自动上下文压缩的触发时机，按 token 数或窗口比例来，省心又省 token。

description.en: Fully local MiniMax H3-Image text-to-image on Apple Silicon MLX — a DeepSeek Harness plugin. 零出网本地文生图插件。
description.zh: 在苹果芯片上完全离线跑 MiniMax H3-Image 文生图，不出网也能出图。

description.en: DSH 的会议记录插件。侧栏一键录音，带实时字幕，转写支持本地与云端；停止后把转写交给当前会话生成纪要，历史会议也能单独发起。列表用徽标显示录制／转写／纪要状态，产物统一存成工作区里的单个 markdown 文件。
DSH Go 原生插件：自动找到手机上的 ADB TCP 端口并保持连接 · Native dsh-go plugin: finds the phone's ADB TCP port and keeps adb connected
description.zh: 自动找到手机 ADB TCP 端口并保持连接，在 DSH 的 bash 里直接 adb shell 用。

description.en: DeepSeek Harness 跨会话知识插件：ctx.knowledge 服务 + knowledge_* 工具，SQLite FTS5 trigram 中文子串检索 + L1 查询扩展（V1.11 契约）
description.zh: 给 DeepSeek Harness 加个跨会话知识库，用 SQLite 全文检索中文，随时存随时查。

description.en: BATMAN! A draggable Batman desktop pet that switches to a mouse-in-hand pose with a thinking bubble while the agent runs, wears random stickers, and shows token usage and wallet balance when you click its laptop. Its HTTP routes have no DSH access check, so a web page open in your browser could call them.
description.zh: 一只可拖动的蝙蝠侠桌宠：Agent 跑动时换成拿鼠标的姿态并冒出思考气泡，骰子随机戴贴纸，点电脑会弹出 token 用量与余额，连点三下可摘面罩。它的 HTTP 路由没有 DSH 的访问检查，浏览器里打开的网页可以调用它们。

description.en: Gives DeepSeek Harness eyes and hands on a Windows desktop: eight MCP tools cover screen capture, mouse and keyboard input, window and process control, files, the registry, PowerShell, the clipboard, virtual desktops and an isolated child session, plus a skill that teaches the model the order to call them in.
description.zh: 给 DeepSeek Harness 装上 Windows 桌面的眼睛和手：8 个 MCP 工具覆盖截屏、鼠标键盘、窗口与进程、文件、注册表、PowerShell、剪贴板、虚拟桌面与独立子会话，另附一份教模型按什么顺序调用它们的技能。

description.en: Replaces the default DeepSeek Harness identity text in the system prompt with a neutral introduction for selected models.
description.zh: 为选中的模型把 DeepSeek Harness 系统提示词中的默认身份介绍替换成通用措辞。

description.en: Bookmark replies, whole turns, selected text, and files in DSH sessions, then jump back to the highlighted spot. Its HTTP routes have no DSH access check, so a web page open in your browser could call them.
description.zh: 收藏 DSH 会话中的回复、整轮对话、选中文字与文件，并一键跳回高亮位置。它的 HTTP 路由没有 DSH 的访问检查，浏览器里打开的网页可以调用它们。

description.en: ComfyUI workbench in the DSH right sidebar: live GPU/CPU/queue status, prompt and sampler controls, generation progress, image gallery, AI prompt writing, and an interactive workflow canvas with optional two-way sync through a ComfyUI bridge extension. Its HTTP routes have no DSH access check, so a web page open in your browser could call them.
description.zh: DSH 右侧栏里的 ComfyUI 工作台：GPU/CPU/队列实时状态、提示词与采样参数、生成进度、图片库、AI 写提示词，以及可通过 ComfyUI 桥接扩展双向同步的工作流画布。它的 HTTP 路由没有 DSH 的访问检查，浏览器里打开的网页可以调用它们。

description.en: Registers your own CNB workspace cnb2api gateway as a DSH model provider at a fixed base URL. Follows the workspace address across restarts, auto-starts a stopped workspace, switches accounts by availability, and shows AI credits and core-hours with a configurable low-credit warning and hard floor. Its HTTP routes have no DSH access check, so a web page open in your browser could call them.
description.zh: 把你自己的 CNB 工作区 cnb2api 网关登记为 DSH 模型供应商，基址固定不变。工作区重启后自动跟随地址、停止后自动拉起、多账号按可用性切换；面板显示 AI credits 与核时，支持自定义余额警戒线和保底停用阈值。它的 HTTP 路由没有 DSH 的访问检查，浏览器里打开的网页可以调用它们。

description.en: Adds per-session routine and enhanced tool review for DeepSeek Harness, with routine review allowing common actions and sending changes such as whole-file overwrites to a separate model for review. Its HTTP routes have no DSH access check, so a web page open in your browser could call them.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供按会话切换的日常与加强审查，日常审查按规则放行常规操作，并在覆盖整个文件等变更前交给独立模型审核。它的 HTTP 路由没有 DSH 的访问检查，浏览器里打开的网页可以调用它们。

description.en: Stardew Valley in a DeepSeek Harness side panel: game day, weather, money, energy, location and the mood curve, with start, wake-the-session, close-with-save-check, force-sleep and scheduled play. Requires the game and SMAPI; the in-game mod is Darian's Blind Whale Farmer.
description.zh: 在 DSH 侧边栏看 AI 玩星露谷：游戏日、天气、钱、体力、地点、心情曲线，可以开始、叫醒、带存档检查关游戏、强制回家睡觉、定时开玩。需要正版游戏和 SMAPI；游戏里的模组是 Darian 的 Blind Whale Farmer。

description.en: Adds a Quick translate panel for English-Chinese translation that streams output from a text model already configured in DSH, with automatic direction detection, a swap button, searchable local history, two switchable looks (paper collage or a plain color-field layout), and an option to save the result as a share image.
description.zh: 新增一个快速翻译面板，用 DSH 中已配置的文字模型做中英互译并流式输出，支持自动判断方向、原文译文互换、可搜索的本地历史、两种可切换的界面风格（纸本拼贴或简洁色场），并可把结果生成分享图片。

description.en: Linkifies Obsidian wiki targets and space-containing Markdown link paths in chat transcripts: resolves the note in the session workspace, opens it in the sidebar Markdown preview, or in the default app with Cmd-click.
description.zh: 把会话正文里的 Obsidian 双链、以及路径带空格因而解析失败的 Markdown 链接，变成可点链接：按会话工作区解析笔记位置，点击在右侧栏预览打开，⌘ 点击交给默认应用。

description.en: Pin any question/answer pair from a DSH conversation into a per-session floating quick-reference list, with draggable placement, one-line previews, a configurable limit, and a full-text overlay.
description.zh: 把 DSH 会话中的任意问答钉成按会话隔离的可拖拽悬浮速查列表，支持单行摘要、可配置上限与点击查看问答详情的遮罩。

description.en: Heartbeat (dsh-self-clock) — the agent sets its own timers: at the due moment it gets one quiet notice in the same conversation, after a five-gate check of whether the user is actually idle. It ships heartbeat_* and presence tools plus a settings panel; timers persist across restarts, and nothing is injected while the model is talking. Its HTTP routes have no DSH access check, so a web page open in your browser could call them.
description.zh: 鱼的心跳（dsh-self-clock）：给智能体自己设的闹钟——到点在同一段对话里收到一句安静的通知，它先看你有没有在说话。带 5 个工具和设置面板，闹钟落盘、重启不丢，模型输出期间不打扰。它的 HTTP 路由没有 DSH 的访问检查，浏览器里打开的网页可以调用它们。

description.en: Turns the empty DSH home screen into a today card: lunar date with the sexagenary day, the day officer (建除) and the day deity, plus ten optional five-star daily readings — health, career, marriage, children, travel, wealth, parents, benefactors, study and romance — scored from the saved four pillars against the day's sexagenary rules. One grey line carries up to four of seven chosen fields (auspicious hours, direction, colour, number, food, gemstone, what to avoid). Birth data stays in local storage, each day is computed once and cached, and the almanac engine ships as a client chunk with no network access.
description.zh: 把 DSH 空首页换成一张「今日」卡片：农历与干支日、建除与值神，十项可勾选的五星运程（健康、事业、夫妻、子女、出行、财运、父母、贵人、学业、桃花），由本命四柱与当日干支规则算出；底栏一行灰字最多显示四个所选字段（今日吉时、开运方向、开运颜色、开运数字、开运食物、开运宝石、今日不宜）。生辰只存本机，每天只算一次并缓存，历法引擎随包以客户端分块加载，不联网。

description.en: Local data console: open CSV/Excel/JSON, profile columns, sort and filter the table, run SQL with joins, draw six chart types and export CSV/XLSX/PNG, with five bounded agent tools.
description.zh: 本地数据工作台：打开 CSV/Excel/JSON，查看列画像、排序筛选、SQL 多表查询、六种图表与 CSV/XLSX/PNG 导出，并向 agent 提供五个有界工具。

description.en: ACL-aware, read-only BM25 gateway to an ai-wiki-template vault: six tools for search, page or section reads, catalog filters, link and backlink checks, index status, and frontmatter lint; Russian Snowball stemming and SQLite FTS5, no vault writes, no Python.
description.zh: 面向 ai-wiki-template 知识库的 ACL 感知只读 BM25 网关：六个工具分别用于检索、读取页面或小节、按分类筛选目录、查看链接与反向链接、索引状态和 frontmatter 校验；使用俄语 Snowball 词干与 SQLite FTS5，不写入知识库，也不需要 Python。

description.en: Replaces the composer model and thinking-level control with an evolution rail from LUCA to a cartoon whale; stage clicks update the session reasoning effort, and model chips switch the model.
description.zh: 把输入框的模型与思考强度控件换成从露卡、海口鱼、提塔利克鱼到大肥鲸的进化轨；点档位更新当前会话的思考强度，点鱼种切换模型。

description.en: Organizes research questions, planned results and supporting evidence in a project workbench with task assignments for specialist agents.
description.zh: 在科研工作台中整理论文研究问题、目标结果及支持证据，并向专业子代理分派任务。

description.en: OpenCode OAuth and OpenCode Go provider for DeepSeek Harness: dual-track OAuth (desktop DB or device flow), auto-probed free models, and quota tracking. Its HTTP routes have no DSH access check, so a web page open in your browser could call them.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 的 OpenCode OAuth 與 OpenCode Go 模型供應商：支援雙軌 OAuth（桌面版 DB 或裝置碼登入）、免費模型自動探測與額度檢視。它的 HTTP 路由没有 DSH 的访问检查，浏览器里打开的网页可以调用它们。

description.en: Backup-first workspace deletion: removes the working directory, session logs and registration only after a full backup, and restores it later.
description.zh: 备份优先的工作删除：先完整备份，再删工作目录、会话日志和登记，之后可从备份恢复。

description.en: Shared memory across every DSH workspace: one knowledge base whose keyword index is injected into each session's system prompt, searchable from the terminal with the kb command or inside a session with the kb_search/kb_read/kb_append tools. Zero dependencies, pure JS; initialization only creates missing files and never overwrites your notes, and the bundled kb CLI ships with a manifest plus three reversible cleanup paths. Its HTTP routes have no DSH access check, so a web page open in your browser could call them.
description.zh: 跨 workspace 共享记忆：一个知识库，关键词索引自动注入每个会话的系统提示，终端用 kb 命令、会话内用 kb_search/kb_read/kb_append 检索与沉淀。零依赖、纯 JS，初始化时只补缺失文件、绝不覆盖你已有的笔记；自带 CLI 安装清单与三条可回退的清理入口。它的 HTTP 路由没有 DSH 的访问检查，浏览器里打开的网页可以调用它们。

description.en: Streams the page running in the agent browser to any LAN web browser over WebSocket, with live clicks, typing and scrolling forwarded back through CDP.
description.zh: 把 agent 浏览器里正在跑的页面通过 WebSocket 转发给局域网内任意浏览器，点击、输入、滚动会经 CDP 回传到原页面。

description.en: Mirrors an Android phone screen into a transparent desktop mini-window from the DSH sidebar: scan a QR code to pair, then the H.264 stream runs over scrcpy through adb outside the browser, with independent content and background opacity, eight-way resize and pin. Bundles adb, scrcpy and the phone-side APK, so nothing else needs installing; Windows hosts only.
description.zh: DSH 侧边栏手机投屏：扫码配对后，画面以 scrcpy 的 H.264 流显示在桌面透明迷你窗里（不进浏览器），支持内容/背景透明度分别调节、八向缩放与置顶。自带 adb、scrcpy 与手机端 APK，无需另装；仅支持 Windows 主机。

description.en: Turns TXT and EPUB novels into narrated or multi-voice audiobooks with Edge TTS, reads chat replies aloud, and gives the agent tools to add, import and queue books.
description.zh: 把 TXT / EPUB 小说做成单人朗读或多角色有声书（Edge TTS），朗读对话里的回答，并为 AI 提供建书、导入和排队制作的工具。

description.en: Changes the DeepSeek Harness desktop app icon (window, taskbar, tray): use your own image or restore the official set. DSH quits and restarts once to apply it. Its HTTP routes have no DSH access check, so a web page open in your browser could call them.
description.zh: 更换 DeepSeek Harness 桌面版的应用图标（窗口、任务栏、托盘）：可以换用自己的图，也可以恢复官方那套。换图标时 DSH 会退出并重启一次。它的 HTTP 路由没有 DSH 的访问检查，浏览器里打开的网页可以调用它们。

description.en: Make the DSH settings dialog movable, resizable and maximizable, remembering its geometry.
description.zh: 把 DSH Web GUI 内置的「设置」弹窗从固定居中、不可调整，变成可拖动、可八向缩放、可双击最大化，并记住上次位置与尺寸的浮层。

description.en: GitHub Copilot sign-in for the built-in github-copilot route, on github.com or a GitHub Enterprise host: a Settings page with a GitHub host field, OAuth device-flow login, and credentials kept in the Harness credential store.
description.zh: 为内置 github-copilot 通道提供 GitHub Copilot 登录，支持 github.com 或 GitHub Enterprise 主机：设置页带 GitHub host 字段，OAuth 设备码登录，凭据存入 Harness 凭据库。

description.en: Plays a two-note bell when the current turn ends and two quick beeps when an approval or a question needs an answer, for the conversation in the main view.
description.zh: 本轮结束响两声上行铃音，出现审批或提问响两声短促蜂鸣，只跟随主视图中的对话。

description.en: Drives an Android VM running inside AndVM over adb, giving the AI tools to read the screen, tap and type, run root shell commands, install APKs and capture screenshots.
description.zh: 通过 adb 驱动 AndVM 里的 Android 虚拟机，给 AI 提供读屏、点击输入、root shell、装 APK 和截图等工具。

description.en: Pick where a session runs before it starts: Local, OCI container or remote SSH host. Commands, file I/O and skills land on the chosen environment, with live CPU / memory / disk monitoring.
description.zh: 启动会话前选择 Local / OCI 容器 / SSH 远端运行环境：命令、文件读写与 Skill 都落到所选环境，并实时监测 CPU、内存与磁盘负载。

description.en: Gives AI characters long-term memory through LLM episode summaries, keyword and time-range recall, reasoning replay, and cue-triggered injection of original conversation text.
description.zh: 给 AI 角色长期记忆：LLM 事件概括、关键词与时间范围召回、思考回读，以及线索触发的原文注入。

description.en: Connects Google Antigravity CLI (agy acp) as a DSH model provider over persistent stdio JSON-RPC sessions, with session/load recovery, native tool card mirroring, reverse MCP bridge, egress geo-fence guard, multi-account quota scheduling, /agy-acp doctor, and a web status panel. Its HTTP routes have no DSH access check, so a web page open in your browser could call them.
description.zh: 通过持久 stdio JSON-RPC 会话将 Google Antigravity CLI（agy acp）接入 DSH 模型提供方，支持 session/load 会话恢复、原生工具卡片镜像、反向 MCP 桥接、出口地域熔断防护、多账号配额调度、/agy-acp doctor 自检及 Web 状态面板。它的 HTTP 路由没有 DSH 的访问检查，浏览器里打开的网页可以调用它们。

description.en: A map-first DeepSeek Harness (DSH) plugin: the session tree is the main mind map, and a frosted floating chat forks a child subtopic when you send its first message. Its HTTP routes have no DSH access check, so a web page open in your browser could call them.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness（DSH）插件：会话树就是主面板思维导图；在毛玻璃浮窗里发送第一条消息，会生成子话题节点。它的 HTTP 路由没有 DSH 的访问检查，浏览器里打开的网页可以调用它们。

description.en: A floating macOS traffic light for DeepSeek Harness: red while a session runs, yellow while one waits for you, green until the finished session is opened — clicking a lit lamp jumps to that session.
description.zh: 贴在屏幕边上的 macOS 红绿灯：会话在跑亮红灯，有东西等你亮黄灯，跑完还没看亮绿灯；点亮着的那盏灯会跳到对应会话。

description.en: MySQL binlog recovery workspace for DSH: generate and preview rollback SQL from a local time range or target SQL, with scan progress and optional temporary-user SQL. Its HTTP routes have no DSH access check, so a web page open in your browser could call them.
description.zh: DSH 的 MySQL binlog 恢复工作区：按本地时间窗口或执行过的 SQL 生成并预览回滚 SQL，显示扫描进度，并可生成临时恢复账号 SQL。它的 HTTP 路由没有 DSH 的访问检查，浏览器里打开的网页可以调用它们。

description.en: 划句批注 DSH 插件：选中一句话留下批注，攒批发给 AI 逐条回答或逐处修改；对话文档可在右侧读、划句，并把结论写回文档。
description.zh: 选中聊天消息或文档里的句子写批注，攒一批发给 AI 逐条回答或修改，结论还能写回文档。

description.en: A project calendar on the DeepSeek Harness main screen: today-only red dot, festival/milestone markers, month/week/day views grouped by project, monthly outcomes, and task-to-chat handoff.
description.zh: 在 DSH 主界面右下角放一张项目日历，月/周/日视图按项目分组看任务，点一下就能跳进对应聊天。
在输入框下加个按钮，一键让当前会话的 agent 根据改动生成 commit message。

description.en: DeepSeek Harness ??:???????????????????(?? / ?? / ??)/ Tells the model its context capacity before each request
description.zh: 每次请求前告诉模型上下文窗口已用了多少，帮它心里有数、少翻车。

description.en: 网课挂机 (dsh-course-autoplay) — DSH 插件：用已登录的浏览器自动播完网课并推进到下一节，带可视化面板、可复用的站点经验与计划文档。
description.zh: 在已登录的浏览器里自动播完网课并跳到下一节，带可视化面板和站点自适应识别。

description.en: DeepSeek Harness plugin: drive the ego lite browser from your agent (run ego-browser scripts, open pages, read snapshots) in the profile you are already signed in to.
description.zh: 让智能体直接操控你已登录的 ego lite 浏览器，跑脚本、开网页、读快照，全程不用重新登录。

description.en: DeepSeek Harness 飞书任务结束通知插件。每轮任务结束时自动向飞书群推送卡片强提醒，支持 @all、可配置 Webhook、卡片标题和正文长度；在 DSH 设置页即可配置并测试。基于自定义机器人 Webhook，无需公网地址。
description.zh: 每轮任务结束自动往飞书群推卡片强提醒，还能扫码建应用私聊指挥，设置页就能配好测试。
把 gostc 内网穿透客户端搬进 Harness 网页端，直接在浏览器里管理穿透隧道。

description.en: Manage Hindsight memory banks from DeepSeek Harness: map DSH workspaces, Bots projects and group chats to their own banks.
description.zh: 在 DSH 里管理 Hindsight 记忆库，把工作区、Bot 项目和群聊分别对应到各自的记忆库。

description.en: DSH 插件：LM Studio 文风润色 —— DSH 负责思考，本地模型只负责说话
description.zh: 让本地 LM Studio 模型给 DSH 的输出做文风润色，思考不变，说话更自然。

description.en: Shape-aware tool-output budgeting for DeepSeek Harness: digest noisy command output before it reaches the model, keep the full text one read away, never truncate errors.
description.zh: 在工具输出进入模型前自动压缩精简，完整原文随时可读，错误信息绝不截断。

description.en: DeepSeek Harness (DSH) plugin: Git-style read-only ABAP change tracker and embedded Diff workbench for abap-adt MCP servers.
description.zh: 给 abap-adt MCP 服务器加个只读的 ABAP 变更追踪和分栏 Diff 面板，随时看清 AI 这轮改了哪些对象。

description.en: Chat mode for DeepSeek Harness: a switch on the sidebar chrome row opens a conversation-only session — no directory, no coding tools, web search, and a configurable system prompt.
description.zh: 侧边栏一键切换到纯聊天模式，去掉目录和编码工具，专注对话，还能自定义系统提示词。

description.en: 编程模式 · 中文：DSH 插件，在标准模式之上强制执行 Superpowers 工程纪律，persona 与 reasoning 默认简体中文。Chinese localization of ziduup/dsh-programming-mode (preset id programming-zh, installable alongside upstream).
description.zh: 给 DSH 加一个中文版「编程模式」，强制按 Superpowers 工程规范干活，默认用简体中文思考和对话。

description.en: Q&A agent preset for DeepSeek Harness: 问答模式 answers with web search instead of a coding toolchain.
description.zh: 给 DeepSeek Harness 加个问答模式，只查资料答问题，不碰你的代码，省心又省额度。

description.en: dsh-run2skill：把 DSH 会话里你明确表达的做事方式，沉淀成可审核、可回滚的原生 Skill。带自有 JSONL 日志、运行代际自检（改了没重启会提示）、技能召回遥测（近 30 天谁被喂给过模型）、发布历史快照（每个 Skill 留 3 版可回滚），左侧栏有「技能沉淀」面板。适合长期用 DSH 干活、反复交代同一套做法的人。
description.zh: 把你在 DSH 里反复交代的做法自动沉淀成可审核、可回滚的 Skill，下次直接复用。

description.en: DSH plugin: push to Bark / ServerChan / webhook when a long session ends, or when a question or approval dialog waits unanswered.
description.zh: 会话结束或弹框等你回应时，通过 Bark、Server酱或 Webhook 推送提醒，不用一直盯着屏幕。

description.en: Sidebar skill switchboard for the DSH web client: list your own skills, switch model/user invocation, check and fix spec problems, edit SKILL.md, import, move, tag, and restore deleted ones.
description.zh: 在侧边栏集中管理你的技能：开关、搜索、校验规范、编辑 SKILL.md，还能导入、打标签和恢复删除。

description.en: DeepSeek Harness 的可视化整合包商店:浏览、搜索、一键安装与卸载插件套装 / A visual suite marketplace for DeepSeek Harness — browse, search, and one-click install plugin suites.
description.zh: 在 DeepSeek Harness 里逛插件套装商店，浏览、搜索、一键装或卸，省去手动折腾。

description.en: DSH 插件：把各插件注册给 Agent 的工具、以及技能（skills）的触发说法汇总成一张中文清单——可搜索、一键复制、可置顶。入口在「对话 / 轨迹 / 画廊」右侧。
description.zh: 把各插件工具和技能的触发说法汇总成中文清单，可搜索、一键复制、可置顶，方便查怎么触发。

description.en: Inject a WeNeed register seed into DeepSeek Harness model requests. No sidecar process, no port, zero npm dependencies.
description.zh: 给 DSH 的模型请求注入 WeNeed 注册种子，让模型稳定保持「We need / Need / We should」的说话风格，随 DSH 启停，零依赖零端口。
自动汇总你一天的工作内容，生成清晰的工作总结，省去手动整理的麻烦。

description.en: AOI Workbench — DeepSeek Harness theme-skin plugin (Gundam EXIA / Emerald skins, floating tile)
description.zh: 给 DeepSeek Harness 换高达和翡翠主题皮肤，右下角悬浮瓷片一键切换，还能管理归档对话。

description.en: Agent-friendly controlled browser automation. Zero retention by default: never writes URLs or credentials to disk.
description.zh: 让 AI 助手直接操控你正在用的 Chrome，把页面元素变成可点击引用，每步都能验证结果，默认不落盘任何网址和账号。

description.en: Local capability ledger for AI agents: index, search, probe and verify the skills, plugins and MCP servers already on your machine, then expose them to the host as an MCP bus.
description.zh: 本机 AI 能力台账：把已安装的技能、插件与 MCP 服务编目、检索、探测并验证，再通过 MCP 总线提供给宿主使用。

description.en: DeepSeek Harness plugin: drive DaVinci Resolve Studio over a local TCP bridge - inspect timelines and node graphs, apply LUTs and CDL, copy grades, export looks, render.
description.zh: 让 DSH 里的 Agent 直接操作 DaVinci Resolve，查看时间线和节点、套 LUT、调色、导出 look 并提交渲染。

description.en: 给 DeepSeek Harness（DSH）加一个真正的「删除会话」动作：把会话日志移入 $DSH_HOME/session-trash，而不只是归档。 A DeepSeek Harness (DSH) plugin that adds a real Delete conversation action: moves the session log into $DSH_HOME/session-trash instead of only archiving it.
description.zh: 给 DSH 会话列表加个真删除，把对话日志移进回收站，随时能捡回来。

description.en: DeepSeek Harness Web 上的 Agent Client Protocol（ACP）客户端
description.zh: 在 DeepSeek Harness Web 里接入 ACP 客户端，自由切换 CodeBuddy、Claude、Codex 等 AI 代理来干活。

description.en: DSH 侧栏活动铃铛（minivv/dsh-activity-bell 的个人 fork）：蓝色角标、正常流替换列表、切换会话冻结快照
description.zh: 给 DSH 侧栏加个活动铃铛，用蓝色角标提示新动态，切换会话时冻结快照，方便回看。

description.en: AeCpt student research workbench plugin for DeepSeek Harness (DSH)
description.zh: 把学生接入自建 AeCpt 科研组服务，在 DSH 里直接做科研工作台。

description.en: Choose how far the DeepSeek Harness right sidebar expands and move keyboard focus to the active page.
description.zh: 让右侧边栏按需展开，并把键盘焦点直接切到当前页面，操作更顺手。

description.en: A UI bridge (not a reverse proxy) that lets the official Antigravity CLI (agy) run as a conversation window inside DeepSeek Harness, via the public ACP interface.
description.zh: 在 DSH 里直接打开本机已登录的 Antigravity CLI，像聊天窗口一样对话使用。

description.en: Native macOS approval dialog for DeepSeek Harness: answer pending tool approvals from outside the window, with the auto-review verdict.
description.zh: 在 macOS 上弹出原生审批弹窗，不用切回窗口就能处理待审批的工具调用，还附带自动审核结论。

description.en: Double-click an archived session in the sidebar to unarchive and open it in one gesture, replacing DSH's native double-click-to-rename.
description.zh: 双击侧栏中的归档会话，自动取消归档并直接打开，同时替代 DSH 原生的双击重命名。

description.en: Drive Aspen Plus V14 from DeepSeek Harness: open a case, run it, read/write flowsheet tree nodes. Contributes 8 MCP tools via ctx.mcpManager.register().
description.zh: 在 DeepSeek Harness 里直接操控 Aspen Plus V14，打开案例、跑模拟、读写流程树节点。

description.en: Review repository changes and history, and keep workspace notes while the agent works.
description.zh: 在侧边栏里查看仓库改动和历史，同时随手记下工作区笔记，干活不丢线索。

description.en: A DeepSeek Harness bundle for sidebar list views, unsent drafts, watched sessions, and active jobs across sessions.
description.zh: 侧边栏列表视图随意切换，未发送草稿一眼可见，关注的会话置顶，还能跨会话查看正在跑的任务。

description.en: Customize DeepSeek Harness appearance with a Claude-like skin, sidebar brand and account card tweaks, wider right sidebar layouts, and DeepSeek pricing hours.
description.zh: 一键给 DeepSeek Harness 换 Claude 风格皮肤，还能调侧边栏布局和隐藏账号卡。

description.en: DeepSeek Harness 自动网络代理插件：自动识别系统代理，搜索 / LLM / 网页三类流量独立开关。Auto network proxy for DSH: Automatic identification system proxy. Toggle for search, LLM and web traffic independently.
description.zh: 自动识别系统代理，搜索、LLM、网页三类流量可分别开关，系统代理一关就全部直连。
